author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Create a professional website in minutes! Do you want one today without coding or hosting fees? In this Google Sites tutorial, I’ll walk you through building a site from a template, customizing the design, adding pages and content, and publishing it live.

What you’ll learn:
  • Start from a template (or blank site)
  • Header setup (banner image, readability + anchoring)
  • Pages + navigation (reorder, dropdowns, links, embeds)
  • Adding content (buttons, images, layouts, spacers/dividers, collapsible groups)
  • Google Drive embeds + sharing permissions
  • Themes + branding (logo, colors, fonts)
  • Preview on mobile + publish (free URL or custom domain option)

Host: Tim Seneker

⌚ TIMESTAMPS
